summary: Keep one global EdgeConneX platform. EQT Infrastructure IV closed the Providence-led acquisition in November 2020, EQT Infrastructure V joined in 2021, Sixth Street acquired a current minority position in 2024, and EQT's AI Infrastructure strategy later acquired a minority interest from IV/V. CPP invested at the EQT strategy level and should not be recorded as a direct EdgeConneX owner absent holder-level evidence. Liberty Global fully exited on June 29, 2026, while the Sweden site purchase remains planned without a verified close.
